event.title: SpaceX conducts sixth integrated flight test of Starship
event.summary_html:
On 19 Nov 2024, SpaceX conducts the sixth integrated flight test of Super Heavy and Starship from Starbase, Texas, using Super Heavy Booster 13 and Starship Ship 31. The test focuses on operational improvements, including heat-shield experiments and a steeper reentry angle to gather thermal-protection-system performance data. The flight carries a banana as a reported payload item. Launch and hot-stage separation succeed, but Booster 13 is diverted to splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico instead of a catch by the Mechazilla tower arms. Ship 31 reignites one Raptor engine in space and completes splashdown in the Indian Ocean after about 1 hour 5 minutes.

On 20 Nov 2024, Musk posts that the ocean landing of Starship was successful and that SpaceX will do one more ocean landing of the ship before attempting a tower catch.

Successful ocean landing of Starship! We will do one more ocean landing of the ship. If that goes well, then SpaceX will attempt to catch the ship with the tower.
